title: Encounter list
description: Response of GET /api/v1/encounters?module=<module>&language=<language>. Both filters are optional. The encounters come back in play order: by module, then order, then difficulty, then id. Summaries only: never the problem text, tests or hints. concept is the encounter's main concept, the one named when a player is defeated.

order.description: Position inside the module, starting at 1.

concept.description: Always the first entry of concepts.
